description.en: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English

description.en: The description of the namespace that you want to create for Microservices Governance.

description.zh: 微服务治理命名空间名称。
description.en: The name of the namespace that you want to create for Microservices Governance.

description.zh: 资源的标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The tag key of the resource. You cannot specify an empty string as a tag key. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

description.zh: 标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`。
description.en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

title.zh: 创建微服务治理命名空间

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse create-namespace --name myNamespace --describe Test_namespace_1. --tag Value=namespaceTagValue Key=namespaceTagKey --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse CreateNamespace --region cn-hangzhou --Describe 'Test_namespace_1.' --AcceptLanguage zh --Tag '[{"Value":"namespaceTagValue","Key":"namespaceTagKey"}]' --Name myNamespace
